acceptance_criteria.criterion: A tracked .md file that hand-asserts volatile git or PR state fails CI -- a branch tip, a commit count, an open-PR assertion, a branch-existence claim
The gate was built fixtures-first: 19 tests failed against an empty stub before any implementation existed, a number two parties measured independently
It catches the real historical failures, proven by an independent reviewer against HANDOFF.md as it stood at 7d9a0b7 -- six findings including all three the gate was built for
The generated HANDOFF block is re-derived and compared rather than exempted, with fields that have no ground truth reported as UNVERIFIABLE in the output rather than silently skipped
Nine evasions found by adversarial review are closed, each with its failing test written first; every case NOT closed is named in the module docstring with a reproducible shape
No CI step can mask another: every gate step in the test job carries if: always(), with no new job or check name that would hang the branch ruleset's required contexts
The gate's honest scope is stated in its own docstring: it makes DOCUMENTS honest, not STATEMENTS, and cannot see a PR body, a commit message, or anything said to the owner

tokens.source: transcript message.usage summed across this session's usage-bearing assistant records. Covers the WHOLE session across PRs 12-18, not this deliverable alone, and EXCLUDES all subagent spend -- this PR alone consumed several hundred thousand subagent tokens across one implementer and one reviewer, none of it in this transcript. A floor, not a total.

unproven: Command tails and sha256 values are SANITIZED before hashing, by a per-session throwaway script rather than committed code. That remains the first open blocker in docs/maintainers/proof-of-completion-plan.md and the reason no historical digest here is independently reproducible.
'commit' names 5ec2955, the substantive head, not the squash-merge commit GitHub creates at merge time.

The env-leak history scan is the AUTHOR's result; the reviewer cannot reproduce it without the repository secret and was instructed not to guess private-name values. CI's own run is the only independent check.

THE SHIPPED INTERACTION TEST DOES NOT EXERCISE WHAT ITS DOCSTRING DESCRIBES. It uses U+FF1A, which NFKC maps one-to-one, so no string length actually changes. The reviewer proved the production code correct by building its own battery with U+FB01, a genuine one-to-two expansion, and separately showed the shipped suite does NOT catch a naive normalise-after-join implementation. The fix is verified sound; its regression test is weaker than claimed, and that is recorded here rather than left in a commit message that reads as if it were stronger.
Three evasions are deliberately open and documented, not fixed: a claim split across a table row and the following line, an en dash standing in for the colon, and a Cyrillic homoglyph in 'main'.

A FOURTH class survives, found in the final review pass: the zero-width strip covers U+200B, U+200C, U+200D and U+FEFF, so U+2060, U+00AD and U+180E still evade the label pattern exactly as U+200B used to. Narrower than the fix's phrasing implies. Not fixed in this PR; it lands in the follow-up alongside the interaction-test correction.
All CI reasoning is static analysis of the workflow file. No reviewer observed a real GitHub Actions run of the reordered steps.

reviewer_id and commit_author_id both embed the same session token. On the evidence this is a SELF-REVIEW: the reviewer is a subagent of the author, and the gate that should prevent that checks only that two strings differ.
This record was written by the author of the work it proves.
